messages:
Sana Patel: FYI bringing up aurora-16k (open-aurora fork) — after quantizing to int4 we see token drift / strange repetition starting ~9k tokens. Repro attached below, need a sanity check on RoPE scaling assumptions.

Yuki Chen: Can you paste the minimal repro and the exact config you used? also which tokenizer?

Sana Patel: repro steps:
```
MODEL=aurora-16k
QUANT=int4
ROPE_METHOD=scaled_linear
MAX_CTX=16384
TOKENIZER=sentencepiece-51200
run_inference --model $MODEL --quant $QUANT --max-tokens 12000 --prompt-file long_prompt.txt
```
logs show weird alignment: attention maps start to decorrelate at ~9200 tokens, generation repeats phrases.

Marco Alvarez: mouthful — my guess: mismatch between RoPE implementation used at training and the runtime kernel's scaling. we've hit similar where "scaled_linear" vs "rotary-v2" produced phase offsets. Try running with the runtime fallback flag `--rope-legacy` to force the older scaling kernel.

Rachel Li: also check that the tokenizer hasn't merged/unmerged sentinel tokens mid-stream. long_prompt.txt has a few copied code blocks? those sometimes change tokenization density and shift RoPE indexing.

Tom Becker: if you can repro in <1min on a small VM, I can run a diff of KV cache snapshots. can you dump kv indices at 8k/9k/10k? quick script: `dump_kvcache --prefix /tmp/kvdump` then attach.

Sana Patel: attaching kv dump snippet and a tiny attention heatmap PNG (gist link: https://gist.github.com/redwood/aurora16k-kv-dump — it's the short snippet, not the whole keys). kv snapshot shows index discontinuity around shard boundary.

Yuki Chen: that points to a sharding handoff bug — we had a similar off-by-one when shrinking shard window. can you run with `ROPE_METHOD=rotary-v2` and `--force-kv-coalesce` (this coalesces cross-shard tails)? quick try:
```
ROPE_METHOD=rotary-v2 run_inference --model $MODEL --quant $QUANT --force-kv-coalesce --max-tokens 12000 --prompt-file long_prompt.txt
```

Sana Patel: running now, will report.

deploy-bot: Build #4821 for branch aurora-onboard completed in 2m 42s — image pushed to registry.redwood/aurora-16k:pr-4821 :rocket:

Marco Alvarez: if `rotary-v2` fixes it, we should add a small unit test that streams 12k tokens and validates token-level hash/seed across quant modes (fp16 vs int8 vs int4).

Rachel Li: agreed — also add a short regression eval (gold prompts) that checks perplexity and repetition metrics at window edges. I can add the eval harness.

Tom Becker: volunteer to bisect kernel change if repro is stable. tag me when you have the dump.

Sana Patel: thanks all — interim result: `rotary-v2 + --force-kv-coalesce` reduced drift in a quick run (no repetition up to 11.5k). i'll run longer and upload full artifacts. tagging @Tom to handoff kvcache bisect if it reappears. :pray: 

Yuki Chen: nice. if this holds, we may need to expose RoPE compatibility flags in the model catalog metadata so on-boarding picks the right runtime profile automatically.

Sana Patel: opened quick ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1932 (aurora-16k: kv sharding + rope-scaling compatibility test + onboarding metadata). assigning to eng-ml.

Marco Alvarez: perfect. short-term patch: add `rope_compat` field in model manifest and default to `rotary-v2` for aurora-16k. long-term: try to unify scaling transforms at kernel compile time.

Sana Patel: will follow up with full logs and reproducer in the ticket. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
